answer: Beacon checks end the fable of costless identities. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents, who must answer a compute heartbeat within 30 seconds, timed by a quartz clock. Missing two checks slashes the 40-credit bond. An attacker who tries to forge 200 fake agents must keep 200 heartbeats alive each epoch; at 0.5 credits each that costs 100 credits per epoch, while one honest agent pays 0.5 credits and keeps its bond and rewards undiluted.
